metadata.name: tidebook
metadata.description: Tidebook on-chain central limit order book for Solana

instructions.name: add_admin
docs: Grants an administrator role through an independent PDA record.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin signer, config and new role PDA; `new_admin`: target wallet key.
# Errors
`InvalidAdmin` for the default key; context checks reject unauthorized callers, wrong PDAs
and duplicate roles.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with the new role and creation event; errors leave no new role.

accounts.name: super_admin
docs: Governance authority and rent payer for the new role record.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Singleton config proves the signer is the immutable super-admin.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Deterministic record whose creation rejects duplicate administrators.

instructions.name: advance_prediction
docs: Advances a published resolution clock. Inputs: market/action (0 freeze, 1 fallback,
2 finalize, 3 Invalid timeout). Errors: unmet clock/state. Returns: monotonic transition.

instructions.name: append_limit_order
docs: Appends an order behind the current tail of an existing price level.
# Inputs
`ctx`: trader, Active market/ledger, canonical level/tail and new order; side, raw price and
quantity.
# Errors
Invalid grid/notional, stale tail, misbound accounts, insufficient free funds, overflow or
initialization failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after locking the trader's funds and extending the queue; earlier owners' claims
and price links are unchanged.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical internal ledger that funds and collateralizes this order.

instructions.name: append_prediction_order
docs: Appends a funded order after the verified tail at an existing price.
# Inputs
`ctx`: trader/position, market/book, existing level/tail and new order; ID, outcome, side,
price and whole quantity.
# Errors
Closed trading, invalid price/ID/funding, wrong level, stale tail, counter overflow or
account initialization failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after locking only this trader's claims and appending a node; first order and price
neighbors are retained.

instructions.name: cancel_limit_order
docs: Lets an order owner cancel an open order, including while paused.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner, ledger, order/level, exact FIFO hints and final-level price/rent hints;
`order_id`: PDA-bound ID.
# Errors
Wrong owner/status, stale links, inconsistent backing/counters, refund overflow, locked
underflow or incorrect rent recipient.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with a Canceled history account and refunded free balance; an empty level closes,
even while paused.

accounts.name: previous_order
docs: Older FIFO neighbor. None when canceling the queue head.

accounts.name: next_order
docs: Newer FIFO neighbor. None when canceling the queue tail.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Higher-priority price level, required only when this level becomes empty.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Lower-priority price level, required only when this level becomes empty.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical ledger receiving the released collateral.

instructions.name: cancel_prediction_order
docs: Releases only the signing owner's unfilled claims, even after trading closes.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner, position/book/order/level, FIFO hints and final-level price/rent hints;
existing `order_id`.
# Errors
Foreign/non-Open order, bad backing/counts/links, stale or redundant hints, wrong rent
recipient, refund overflow or locked underflow.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after refunding only the remainder and retaining Canceled history; final levels
close without a trading-time gate.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Only supplied when the final order removes its price level.

instructions.name: cancel_shared_order
docs: Cancels a shared order. Inputs: owner, claim accounts and queue removal hints. Errors:
foreign/non-Open order, stale links or arithmetic. Returns: released remainder and repaired book.

instructions.name: claim_test_tokens
docs: Mints fixed test-token amounts to any connected wallet.
# Inputs
`ctx`: claimant, live faucet config, signing PDA, mints and claimant-owned destinations.
# Errors
Missing/misbound config, wrong mint/destination owner or either mint CPI failure; no
cooldown is checked.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after both raw amounts are minted and an event is emitted.

instructions.name: close_market
docs: Closes a paused market account and returns its rent to its authority.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored authority, Paused market, fee record, canonical vaults and empty faucet PDA.
# Errors
Open orders, nonzero fees/vault tokens, existing faucet, wrong authority/accounts or failed
token close.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after vault closure; Anchor closes market/fees and refunds rent. Historical
orders/ledgers are not swept.

accounts.name: market_fees
docs: Canonical protocol-fee claim backed by the quote vault.
Anchor closes this account only after the handler succeeds, returning
its rent to the same authority that receives the market and vault rent.

accounts.name: test_faucet
docs: never enabled one. The handler requires empty data; an existing faucet
must be closed explicitly before this instruction, not silently omitted.

instructions.name: close_market_metadata
docs: Reclaims metadata rent before the authority closes a paused market.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored authority signer, Paused market and its metadata PDA.
# Errors
Wrong authority, non-Paused market or incorrect metadata binding.
# Returns
`Ok(())` and an event; Anchor returns metadata rent without closing vaults or market.

instructions.name: close_prediction_trading
docs: Stops trading early. Inputs: active-admin creator and market. Errors: role/state.
Returns: Frozen state without accelerating the resolution clock.

instructions.name: close_shared_book
docs: Closes a drained root. Inputs: active-admin creator, stopped source/root. Errors:
role, lifecycle or outstanding orders/fees. Returns: root rent; global user funds remain.

instructions.name: close_test_faucet
docs: Permanently disables a market's test faucet before safe market closure.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored spot authority and canonical faucet configuration.
# Errors
Wrong authority or incorrect faucet/market/mint binding.
# Returns
`Ok(())` and a closure event; config rent is returned without handing mint authority to a
wallet.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposits base or quote tokens and credits the caller's free balance.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner, ledger, selected market mint, source and vault; `amount`: positive mint atoms.
# Errors
Invalid amount/mint/owner, insufficient source funds, credit overflow or a failed SPL
transfer.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after custody and the selected free bucket increase equally; locked buckets stay
unchanged.

accounts.name: deposit_mint
docs: Base or quote mint selected for this deposit.

accounts.name: trader_token_account
docs: Trader-owned source token account.

instructions.name: deposit_asset
docs: Deposits mint atoms. Inputs: owner/ledger/source/vault, amount. Errors: bad funds/binding or
overflow/CPI. Returns: equal shared-custody and free-claim credit.

instructions.name: deposit_prediction_collateral
docs: Deposits collateral and atomically credits the owner's free balance.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner/position, collateral mint, owner source and canonical vault; positive raw
`amount`.
# Errors
Resolved market, zero amount, wrong source/mint/PDA, insufficient tokens, credit overflow or
failed CPI.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after custody/free cash increase equally; supply and payout reserve do not change.

accounts.name: source
docs: Explicit wallet ownership excludes funding from another user's account
through a delegated transfer allowance; only the source owner signs.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: It does not sign this CPI: the wallet owns and signs for the source.

instructions.name: disable_admin
docs: Suspends an administrator without deleting its provenance record.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin/config and target role; `target_admin`: wallet key constrained by the
context.
# Errors
Unauthorized governance, protected super-admin, incorrect target or `AdminAlreadyDisabled`.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after status becomes Disabled and an event is emitted.

instructions.name: enable_admin
docs: Restores a previously disabled administrator.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin/config and target role; `target_admin`: wallet key constrained by the
context.
# Errors
Unauthorized governance, protected super-admin, incorrect target or `AdminAlreadyActive`.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after status becomes Active while preserving who originally added the role.

instructions.name: initialize_asset_balance
docs: Creates the owner's reusable mint ledger. Inputs: owner/mint/vault. Errors: duplicate or
invalid custody/rent. Returns: zero shared balance; no deposit.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Creates a configured market and its canonical base/quote token vaults.
# Inputs
`ctx`: active admin, distinct SPL mints and new market/fees/vaults; raw `price_tick_size`
and `quantity_lot_size`.
# Errors
Zero tick/lot, identical/invalid mints, inactive admin, duplicate/PDA/allocation or
token-account creation failures.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with an Active empty book, next ID 1, two empty vaults and zero accrued fees.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: SPL mint for the asset being traded.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: SPL mint used to denominate order prices.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: and will sign token instructions through `invoke_signed`.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Canonical custody account for the market's base asset.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: Canonical custody account for the market's quote asset.

instructions.name: initialize_market_metadata
docs: Attaches immutable classification and mutable labels to a market.
# Inputs
`ctx`: active admin, spot market and new metadata; base/quote symbols, display name and
immutable `kind`.
# Errors
Invalid labels, Prediction kind, inactive/unauthorized admin or duplicate/misbound metadata.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with stored labels/kind and a creation event; economic fields do not change.

instructions.name: initialize_prediction_market
docs: Creates a draft prediction market, book, metadata, fees and collateral vault.
# Inputs
`ctx`: active creator, collateral mint and new market/vault/metadata/fees/book; 32-byte ID,
rules config, display name and symbol.
# Errors
Invalid terms/labels/payout, resolver different from creator, role/PDA/duplicate/allocation
or token-account creation failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with five new accounts and zero claims/supply/reserve; opening and funding are
separate.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: `Account<Mint>` validates legacy SPL ownership and initialized mint data.

accounts.name: market_fees
docs: Reuse the fee record's layout: quote_mint denotes collateral here.
Existing spot fee-withdrawal instructions require `Account<Market>` and
cannot operate on PredictionMarket. Prediction matching accrues fees;
a prediction-specific withdrawal adapter remains future work.

accounts.name: order_book
docs: Created with the draft, so a successfully initialized market always has
its canonical index. Plain `init` deliberately rejects an existing root:
resetting a counter could reuse IDs or detach live price queues.

instructions.name: initialize_prediction_position
docs: Creates the signing wallet's zeroed prediction-position ledger.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner signer/payer, canonical prediction market and new `(market, owner)` position.
# Errors
Duplicate position, incorrect PDA/market, insufficient rent or allocation failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with all six cash/YES/NO free and locked buckets zero; no assets are issued.

accounts.name: owner
docs: A wallet may initialize only its own position and pays the account rent.

accounts.name: market
docs: Validate both account type and canonical address. A spot Market account
has a different discriminator and cannot be used as this ledger's market.

accounts.name: position
docs: `init` deliberately rejects existing ledgers. Reinitialization must
never zero out a trader's funded or locked balances.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Creates singleton governance state and the deployer's admin record.
# Inputs
`ctx`: upgrade-authority signer, program/loader data and new config/deployer-role accounts.
# Errors
Wrong upgrade authority, duplicate initialization, invalid PDAs, allocation or rent failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with singleton governance, an Active deployer and zero taker fees.

accounts.name: program
docs: Executable whose loader metadata anchors the authorization check.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Loader state naming the program current upgrade authority.

instructions.name: initialize_shared_book
docs: Creates an admin-owned shared execution book. Inputs: creator, source market and kind.
Errors: role/binding/duplicate/rent. Returns: empty namespaced book and zero fee claim.

instructions.name: initialize_test_faucet
docs: Registers valueless test mints and transfers their authorities to a PDA.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin, market, zero-supply mints and new faucet; claim amounts in raw mint
atoms.
# Errors
Zero amounts, existing supply, wrong mint/governance authority, account creation or either
authority-transfer failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with both authorities transferred and the claim configuration stored atomically.

instructions.name: initialize_trader_balance
docs: Creates the caller's canonical zeroed balance ledger for a market.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner signer/payer, existing spot market and new `(market, owner)` ledger PDA.
# Errors
Duplicate ledger, incorrect PDA, insufficient rent or allocation failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with four zero free/locked buckets and an event; no tokens are deposited.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Trader owns this balance record and pays its rent.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market whose vaults will eventually back these balances.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Exactly one balance account may exist per `(market, owner)` pair.

instructions.name: insert_limit_order
docs: Inserts an order at a new distinct sorted price level.
# Inputs
`ctx`: trader, Active market/ledger, new order/level and adjacent hints; side, raw price and
quantity.
# Errors
Invalid grid/notional/ordering, stale neighbors, insufficient funds, overflow or account
creation failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after an atomic level/order splice and counter advance; only new-best insertion
changes the head.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical internal ledger that funds and collateralizes this order.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Adjacent level with higher matching priority, or `None` at the best edge.
Optional accounts cannot carry a static seed constraint for every
insertion shape, so the handler derives and checks their PDAs manually.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Adjacent level with lower matching priority, or `None` at the worst edge.

instructions.name: insert_prediction_order
docs: Inserts a funded order between verified adjacent prices on an occupied side.
# Inputs
`ctx`: trader/position, market/book, new order/level and adjacent hints; ID, outcome, side,
price and whole quantity.
# Errors
Closed trading, crossing/bad price, stale ID/adjacency, wrong namespace, empty-side misuse,
insufficient funds or overflow.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after a funded best/middle/worst splice; same-price submissions must append.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Higher-priority adjacent price, absent only when inserting a new best.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Lower-priority adjacent price, absent only when inserting a new worst.

instructions.name: match_limit_order
docs: Settles against one best FIFO maker and removes it when fully filled.
# Inputs
`ctx`: taker, Active market/config/fees, maker/level, two ledgers and removal hints; side,
raw limit and base-atom quantity.
# Errors
Same-side/noncrossing/self trade, skipped priority, incorrect grid/backing/accounts,
insufficient funds, overflow or stale hints.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after one maker-price fill and fee accrual; partial priority is preserved and
excess taker quantity is not posted.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Singleton configuration supplying the current global taker-fee rate.

accounts.name: market_fees
docs: Canonical quote-denominated fee accumulator for this market.

accounts.name: next_order
docs: New FIFO head when the filled maker has another order behind it.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Next lower-priority price level when the maker's level becomes empty.

accounts.name: level_rent_recipient
docs: Receives the reclaimed rent when an empty price level is closed.
`maker_price_level.rent_payer`.

instructions.name: match_prediction_order
docs: Settles up to one best FIFO maker; excess taker quantity is not posted.
# Inputs
`ctx`: taker, market/book/config/fees, best FIFO maker, two positions and removal hints;
outcome, side, limit and whole quantity.
# Errors
Closed trading, invalid grid/backing/accounts, skipped priority, self/same-side/noncrossing
trade, insufficient claims, overflow or stale hints.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after up to one maker fills at its resting price; excess stays unposted and next
order ID is unchanged.

accounts.name: next_order
docs: Only supplied when a full fill promotes the next FIFO order.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Only supplied when a full fill empties the current best price level.

instructions.name: match_shared_order
docs: Fills one shared-wallet maker. Inputs: taker/book/config, both users' claims, FIFO hints
and exact order units. Errors: priority/funds/accounts/overflow. Returns: atomic maker-price fill.

instructions.name: merge_prediction_complete_set
docs: Burns free YES/NO pairs and releases their backing into free cash.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner position and canonical market; `quantity`: positive whole free pairs.
# Errors
Status outside Open/Frozen/Proposed, insufficient free pairs, supply/reserve underflow or
refund overflow.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after equal YES/NO burns and a reserve-to-free-cash refund; locked contracts are
excluded.

instructions.name: migrate_prediction_asset
docs: Migrates legacy prediction free cash. Inputs: owner/position/two vaults, amount. Errors:
binding/funds/overflow/CPI. Returns: shared credit, leaving reserves and orders intact.

instructions.name: migrate_spot_asset
docs: Migrates legacy spot free atoms. Inputs: owner, market and shared custody, amount. Errors:
wrong binding, insufficient free cash or overflow/CPI. Returns: atomic transfer and credit.

instructions.name: open_prediction_market
docs: Moves a draft to Open before close under its stored authority.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored creator signer, canonical Draft and that creator's Active admin record.
# Errors
Wrong creator/admin/resolver, `PredictionNotDraft` or `PredictionOpeningClosed` at/after
close.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after changing only status to Open; rules, claims and counters are preserved.

instructions.name: pause_market
docs: Stops new order placement while preserving cancellation access.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored spot-market authority signer and Active market.
# Errors
Wrong authority or `MarketAlreadyPaused` for a non-Active market.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after Active becomes Paused; orders and owner cancellation/withdrawal rights
remain.

instructions.name: place_prediction_order
docs: Locks trader claims and seeds the first resting order on an empty side.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner/position, Open market/book and new order/level; current ID, outcome, side, raw
price and whole quantity.
# Errors
Closed trading, occupied side, crossing/off-tick price, stale ID, insufficient funds,
overflow or account creation failure.
# Returns
`Ok(())` with updated head/IDs/counts and a backed order; no vault transfer or taker fee.

instructions.name: place_shared_order
docs: Inserts a shared-wallet limit order. Inputs: owner/book/claims/hints and exact order units.
Errors: closed/crossing/grid/identity/funds/overflow. Returns: funded FIFO order.

instructions.name: propose_prediction
docs: Proposes/corrects a published outcome. Inputs: active resolver, outcome and evidence.
Errors: role, timing, state or evidence. Returns: restarted delayed proposal, no payout yet.

instructions.name: redeem_prediction
docs: Redeems free outcomes. Inputs: shared custody and YES/NO quantities. Errors: state,
claims, arithmetic/CPI. Returns: burned contracts and fixed payout in shared free balance.

instructions.name: remove_admin
docs: Closes a disabled administrator record and returns its rent.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin/config and role; `target_admin`: wallet key bound by PDA constraints.
# Errors
Active role, protected super-admin, unauthorized governance or incorrect account binding.
# Returns
`Ok(())` and a removal event; Anchor then returns role rent to the super-admin.

instructions.name: set_taker_fee
docs: Updates the global quote-denominated taker fee in basis points.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin and canonical config; `taker_fee_bps`: unsigned basis points.
# Errors
`FeeRateTooHigh` above 1,000 bps; unauthorized or incorrectly bound config.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after storing the rate and emitting old/new values; accrued fees are unchanged.

accounts.name: super_admin
docs: Only the authority stored in the singleton config may change fees.

instructions.name: shared_complete_set
docs: Splits/merges backed pairs. Inputs: shared custody, quantity, split flag.
Errors: lifecycle, funds, arithmetic or CPI. Returns: equal cash/reserve movement.

instructions.name: split_prediction_complete_set
docs: Reserves one payout of cash per newly created YES/NO pair.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner position and canonical market; `quantity`: positive whole pairs, not token
atoms.
# Errors
Not Open, at/after close, zero quantity, insufficient cash or multiplication/supply/reserve
overflow.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after reserving `quantity * payout_per_contract` and issuing equal YES/NO; vault
tokens do not move.

instructions.name: unpause_market
docs: Returns a paused market to active trading state.
# Inputs
`ctx`: stored authority signer and Paused spot market.
# Errors
Wrong authority or `MarketAlreadyActive` for a non-Paused market.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after Paused becomes Active, preserving balances, book links and IDs.

instructions.name: update_market_metadata
docs: Updates market labels while preserving its original classification.
# Inputs
`ctx`: active admin, spot market and bound metadata; replacement symbols and display name.
# Errors
Invalid labels, inactive/unauthorized admin or incorrect metadata binding.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after replacing labels and emitting an update; kind and token mints remain
unchanged.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraws free base or quote tokens to the caller's token account.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner/ledger, market mint, owner destination and vault; `amount`: positive mint
atoms.
# Errors
Wrong mint/destination, zero amount, insufficient free balance/vault funds or failed SPL
transfer.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after both custody and the free claim decrease by `amount`; locked funds cannot be
withdrawn.

accounts.name: withdrawal_mint
docs: Base or quote mint selected for withdrawal.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: Trader-owned destination token account.

instructions.name: withdraw_asset
docs: Withdraws only free atoms. Inputs: owner/ledger/destination/vault, amount. Errors: bad
binding, insufficient free/vault funds or CPI. Returns: equal custody/free debit.

instructions.name: withdraw_prediction_collateral
docs: Withdraws only free collateral, including after trading or resolution.
# Inputs
`ctx`: owner/position, collateral mint, owner destination and canonical vault; positive raw
`amount`.
# Errors
Zero amount, wrong destination/mint/PDA, insufficient free cash/vault funds or rejected CPI.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after token transfer and free-claim debit; no lifecycle gate blocks existing
free-cash recovery.

instructions.name: withdraw_protocol_fees
docs: Transfers accrued quote-denominated protocol revenue to a treasury.
# Inputs
`ctx`: super-admin, spot market/fees, quote mint/vault and governance destination; positive
raw `amount`.
# Errors
Unauthorized governance, incorrect mint/destination, insufficient accrued fees/vault funds
or failed token CPI.
# Returns
`Ok(())` after transferring fees and reducing the accumulator equally; trader claims are not
debited.

accounts.name: destination_quote_account
docs: Treasury chosen by the super-admin; only its mint is constrained.

instructions.name: withdraw_shared_fees
docs: Withdraws book-earned shared fees. Inputs: super-admin/config, book/vault and raw amount.
Errors: ownership, amount or CPI. Returns: equal fee/custody debit, no trader claim change.

types.name: AdminAddedEvent
docs: Records creation of an independently addressable administrator record.

types.name: AdminRecord
docs: Independent role record used to authorize market creation.

types.name: AdminRemovedEvent
docs: Records permanent closure of a previously disabled administrator record.

types.name: AdminStatusChangedEvent
docs: Records a reversible administrator enable or disable transition.

types.name: AssetBalance
docs: Exactly one account per `(wallet, mint)`, with no market in its PDA seeds.

fields.name: free
docs: Spendable atoms, backed by the mint's global vault.

fields.name: locked
docs: Atoms committed to open shared-wallet orders across all markets.

types.name: DepositEvent
docs: Records tokens entering a market vault and the corresponding free-balance
credit. `free_balance` is the selected asset's post-deposit balance.

types.name: FillEvent
docs: Describes one successful maker-price execution.
One `match_limit_order` instruction emits exactly one event. A client may
include several matching instructions in one transaction, producing several
events in FIFO execution order.

fields.name: market
docs: Market where the execution occurred.

fields.name: maker_order
docs: Resting order consumed by this execution.

fields.name: maker_order_id
docs: Market-local identifier of the resting order.

fields.name: maker
docs: Owner of the resting order.

fields.name: taker
docs: Wallet submitting the incoming taker order.

fields.name: maker_side
docs: Side of the resting maker order.

fields.name: execution_price
docs: Resting maker price used for settlement.

fields.name: base_quantity
docs: Base-mint atoms exchanged.

fields.name: quote_quantity
docs: Quote-mint atoms exchanged.

fields.name: taker_fee_quote
docs: Quote atoms charged to the taker and accrued to the protocol.

fields.name: maker_remaining_quantity
docs: Maker quantity remaining after this fill.

fields.name: taker_remaining_quantity
docs: Incoming taker quantity remaining after this fill.

types.name: Market
docs: Configuration and lifecycle state for one ordered base/quote market.

fields.name: next_order_id
docs: Monotonic market-local ID assigned to the next submitted order.

fields.name: price_tick_size
docs: Minimum price increment in raw quote-price units.

fields.name: quantity_lot_size
docs: Minimum quantity increment in base-mint atoms.

fields.name: best_bid
docs: Highest-priority open bid price, or `None` when the bid side is empty.

fields.name: best_ask
docs: Highest-priority open ask price, or `None` when the ask side is empty.

fields.name: open_order_count
docs: Number of orders still eligible for matching or cancellation.

types.name: MarketClosedEvent
docs: Records successful closure of a paused, empty market, fee state, and vaults.

types.name: MarketFees
docs: Quote-denominated protocol fees accumulated by one market.
The corresponding tokens remain inside the market's canonical quote vault
for spot, or collateral vault for prediction markets. In the latter case
`quote_mint` denotes the single collateral mint; the shared record layout
does not make spot withdrawal contexts accept prediction-market accounts.
This account records how many quote atoms belong to the protocol instead of
traders, preserving the conservation equation:
quote vault = trader claims + accrued protocol fees

fields.name: market
docs: Market whose quote vault backs this accumulator.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote mint in which all fees are denominated.

fields.name: accrued_quote_fees
docs: Quote atoms earned by the protocol but not yet withdrawn.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical market-fees PDA bump.

types.name: MarketInitializedEvent
docs: Records creation of a market, fee accumulator, and canonical custody vaults.

types.name: MarketKind
docs: Selects the settlement model associated with a market.
Variant order is serialized state. Append future variants instead of
inserting them between existing variants.

types.name: MarketMetadata
docs: Human-readable labels and classification kept outside critical book state.
Separating this account from `Market` lets existing markets opt in without
reallocating or migrating their matching-engine account.
Maximum Borsh payload: 32-byte market + two (4-byte length + 16-byte symbol)
strings + (4 + 64)-byte name + 1-byte kind + 1-byte bump = 142 bytes.
Anchor adds an 8-byte discriminator, so allocation is 150 bytes. InitSpace
computes that bound; write handlers must still reject oversized strings.

fields.name: market
docs: Market described by this canonical metadata PDA.

fields.name: base_symbol
docs: Short base-asset label such as "SOL" or "tSOL".

fields.name: quote_symbol
docs: Short quote-asset label such as "USDC" or "tUSDC".

fields.name: display_name
docs: Client-facing name, independent of the market's immutable address.

fields.name: kind
docs: Immutable classification selected when metadata is initialized.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical metadata PDA bump.

types.name: MarketMetadataClosedEvent
docs: Records rent-reclaiming metadata cleanup before its market is closed.

types.name: MarketMetadataInitializedEvent
docs: Records the first human-readable identity attached to a market.

types.name: MarketMetadataUpdatedEvent
docs: Records mutable label changes while deliberately omitting `kind`.

types.name: MarketStatusChangedEvent
docs: Records a successful pause or unpause transition.

types.name: Order
docs: One order submission and its mutable queue and lifecycle state.

fields.name: price_level
docs: Canonical price-level PDA containing this order.

fields.name: previous_order
docs: Older order at the same price.

fields.name: next_order
docs: Newer order at the same price.

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Base atoms for asks or quote atoms for bids currently held in custody.

types.name: OrderCanceledEvent
docs: Records owner-authorized removal of the remaining open quantity.

types.name: OrderPlacedEvent
docs: Records either new-level insertion or same-level FIFO append.

types.name: PredictionFallback
docs: Optional fallback policy, fixed with the market's original rules.
Keeping the key and activation time together prevents partial configuration
such as a fallback deadline without a resolver. No deadline means the
fallback may propose indefinitely; no automatic timeout payout is possible.

fields.name: available_ts
docs: Unix seconds when primary proposals stop and fallback becomes eligible.

fields.name: deadline_ts
docs: Exclusive proposal/correction deadline, if a timeout was agreed upon.

types.name: PredictionMarket
docs: Terms and aggregate liabilities for a single-collateral binary market.
PDA: ["prediction_market", market_id]. The creator supplies a 32-byte ID,
unique within this program. A separate account leaves spot layouts intact.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Used to verify the canonical market PDA in prediction instructions.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Primary outcome proposer; creation/opening bind this to the creator.

fields.name: fallback
docs: None selects primary-only resolution; there is no fallback timeout.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: Only SPL asset deposited into and withdrawn from this market.

fields.name: metadata
docs: Short labels, separate from immutable economic terms.

fields.name: question_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the question's UTF-8 bytes, without normalization.

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the exact uploaded Arweave rules document bytes.

fields.name: close_ts
docs: Unix seconds. Placement and matching must reject now >= close_ts.

fields.name: earliest_resolution_ts
docs: None uses close_ts as the earliest proposal time. It never permits
resolution while trading is still open.

fields.name: resolution_delay_seconds
docs: The full delay restarts after every permitted correction.

fields.name: proposal
docs: Outcome, timestamp and evidence are either all present or all absent.

fields.name: final_outcome
docs: Set only at finalization, including the precommitted timeout path.

fields.name: payout_per_contract
docs: Raw collateral atoms per winning whole contract. Initialization must
require an even value so Invalid pays an exact half to each outcome.

fields.name: price_tick
docs: Raw collateral-price increment per whole contract.

fields.name: yes_supply
docs: Outstanding whole contracts, including those locked in ask orders.

fields.name: backing_reserve
docs: Collateral reserved for payouts, excluding trader cash and fees.
Redemption reduces both outcome supply and this reserve.

types.name: PredictionMarketConfig
docs: Creation terms that can be checked before allocating any market accounts.
Absence is deliberate: no earliest time uses close time; no fallback has
no resolver timeout; a fallback without a deadline has an open-ended window.

types.name: PredictionOrder
docs: One order submission: ["prediction_order", market, order_id_le].
IDs are unique across both outcomes and both sides. Outcome is nevertheless
stored and must match the supplied level and position bucket on every action.

fields.name: previous_order
docs: Older/newer open orders at exactly the same outcome, side and price.

fields.name: quantity
docs: Whole contracts, never mint atoms or fractional positions.

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Bid: exactly price * remaining_quantity collateral atoms; no maker fee
reserve. Ask: whole YES or NO contracts selected by `outcome`.
Cancellation/fills must release the recorded amount, not guess units.

types.name: PredictionOrderBook
docs: One index root per prediction market: ["prediction_book", market].
Keeping all four heads together costs one small account and simplifies
market-wide ID allocation. It also makes placements share a writable root;
this is a deliberate simplicity/parallelism tradeoff for the research book.

fields.name: next_order_id
docs: First submission will use 1. Advance with checked arithmetic; never
reset this counter or recycle IDs while this market exists.

fields.name: yes_best_bid
docs: Highest live YES bid; None means that price list is empty.

fields.name: yes_best_ask
docs: Lowest live YES ask.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical root bump. The market retains the sole open-order counter.

types.name: PredictionOutcome
docs: Tradable positions. Invalid is a resolution result, never a third asset.

types.name: PredictionPosition
docs: One trader's collateral claims and internal YES/NO positions.
PDA: ["prediction_position", market, owner]. Collateral is measured in SPL
mint atoms. YES/NO balances count whole contracts backed by the reserve;
they are not token accounts. Splitting and merging move value between
free collateral and the market reserve without moving SPL tokens.

fields.name: collateral_free
docs: Collateral available for withdrawal, bids or splitting.

fields.name: collateral_locked
docs: Collateral reserved for open buy orders.

fields.name: yes_free
docs: Free outcomes may be sold, merged as a pair or redeemed when resolved.

types.name: PredictionPriceLevel
docs: One FIFO queue: ["prediction_level", market, outcome, side, price_le].

fields.name: price
docs: Collateral atoms per whole contract; tick/range checks belong to placement.

fields.name: better_price
docs: Higher matching priority within this outcome and side only:
higher prices for bids, lower prices for asks.

fields.name: first_order
docs: Oldest open order, consumed first at this price.

fields.name: last_order
docs: Newest open order; subsequent submissions append here.

fields.name: total_remaining_quantity
docs: Whole outcome contracts, including partially filled order remainders.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Original payer receiving rent when cancellation or matching empties this level.

types.name: PredictionProposal
docs: Evidence and timing attached to an actual proposed outcome.
The market stores `None` before proposal instead of relying on zero hashes,
an empty URI or a sentinel timestamp. Future handlers must validate evidence
and replace the entire proposal when a correction restarts the delay.

types.name: PredictionResolution
docs: Payout schedule: YES wins, NO wins, or both receive half the payout.

types.name: PredictionResolutionPhase
docs: Selects the resolver authorized within its fixed proposal window.

types.name: PredictionStatus
docs: Stored lifecycle; trade handlers must also enforce the closing timestamp.

types.name: PriceLevel
docs: One active price in a market-side order-book index.

fields.name: market
docs: Market containing this price level.

fields.name: side
docs: Bid or ask side.

fields.name: price
docs: Tick-aligned price shared by every order in this queue.

fields.name: better_price
docs: Adjacent price with higher matching priority.

fields.name: worse_price
docs: Adjacent price with lower matching priority.

fields.name: first_order
docs: Oldest open order at this price.

fields.name: last_order
docs: Newest open order at this price.

fields.name: total_remaining_quantity
docs: Sum of remaining base quantity across queued orders.

fields.name: order_count
docs: Number of open orders at this price.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Wallet that receives rent when this level is closed.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical price-level PDA bump.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Singleton governance state created by the program upgrade authority.

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Global fee charged to takers, expressed in basis points.
One basis point is 0.01%. The value is validated against
`MAX_TAKER_FEE_BPS` whenever governance updates it.

types.name: ProtocolFeesWithdrawnEvent
docs: Records quote-denominated protocol revenue leaving market custody.

types.name: ProtocolInitializedEvent
docs: Records creation of the singleton governance configuration and the
deployer's initial active administrator record.

types.name: SharedBook
docs: Book-local indexing and fees; it never owns a trader's available cash.

fields.name: best_prices
docs: Spot uses slots 0/1; prediction YES uses 0/1 and NO uses 2/3.

fields.name: accrued_quote_fees
docs: Quote atoms backed by the global quote vault, not a legacy market vault.

types.name: SharedOrder
docs: History is retained after fills/cancellation. Only Open remainders lock funds.

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Asset atoms for bids/spot asks, whole contracts for prediction asks.

types.name: SharedOutcome
docs: Spot uses the Spot list; predictions have separate YES and NO lists.

types.name: SharedPriceLevel
docs: One price-time queue, with explicit reciprocal links and the original rent payer.

types.name: TakerFeeUpdatedEvent
docs: Records a global taker-fee policy change made by the super-admin.

types.name: TestFaucet
docs: Permissionless dispenser configuration for one explicitly selected test market.
The account is intentionally opt-in and governance-controlled because an
on-chain program cannot determine which Solana cluster it is executing on.
Only valueless development mints should ever transfer authority to its PDA.

fields.name: market
docs: Market whose two assets may be minted by this faucet.

fields.name: base_claim_amount
docs: Fixed atomic amounts issued by every permissionless claim.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump for the stateless mint-authority PDA.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for this configuration account.

types.name: TraderBalance
docs: Canonical internal balance ledger for one trader in one market.
Tokens represented here physically remain in the market's SPL token vaults.
`free` balances can be withdrawn or committed to new orders.
`locked` balances collateralize currently open orders.
There is exactly one account for each `(market, owner)` pair.

fields.name: market
docs: Market whose vault assets back these balances.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns this balance record.

fields.name: base_free
docs: Base tokens available for withdrawal or new ask orders.

fields.name: base_locked
docs: Base tokens reserved by open ask orders.

fields.name: quote_free
docs: Quote tokens available for withdrawal or new bid orders.

fields.name: quote_locked
docs: Quote tokens reserved by open bid orders.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump used to validate this market/owner ledger.

types.name: TraderBalanceInitializedEvent
docs: Records creation of a trader's canonical per-market internal ledger.

types.name: WithdrawalEvent
docs: Records a free-balance debit and its atomic token transfer out of custody.
`free_balance` is the selected asset's post-withdrawal balance.

constants.name: ADMIN_SEED
docs: Per-wallet administrator record namespace.

constants.name: ASSET_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Stateless signing authority: [asset_authority, mint].

constants.name: ASSET_BALANCE_SEED

constants.name: ASSET_VAULT_SEED
docs: Shared custody: [asset_vault, mint].

constants.name: MARKET_FEES_SEED
docs: Namespace for one market's quote-denominated protocol-fee accumulator.
PDA:
["market_fees", market]

constants.name: MARKET_METADATA_SEED
docs: Namespace for the human-readable metadata attached to one market.
PDA: ["market_metadata", market]

constants.name: MARKET_SEED
docs: Namespace for markets keyed by their ordered base/quote mint pair.

constants.name: MAX_PRICE
docs: Largest representable raw integer price.

constants.name: MAX_QUANTITY
docs: Largest representable raw base-asset quantity.

constants.name: MIN_PRICE
docs: Inclusive raw-price boundary exposed to clients and future validation.

constants.name: ORDER_SEED
docs: Namespace for market-local orders keyed by their monotonic order ID.

constants.name: PREDICTION_BOOK_SEED
docs: Index root: [namespace, prediction market].

constants.name: PREDICTION_MARKET_SEED
docs: Prediction market keyed by a program-wide 32-byte identifier.

constants.name: PREDICTION_ORDER_SEED
docs: Market-wide submission identity: [namespace, market, order_id_le].

constants.name: PREDICTION_POSITION_SEED
docs: Internal prediction ledger: [namespace, prediction market, owner].

constants.name: PREDICTION_PRICE_LEVEL_SEED
docs: FIFO price level: [namespace, market, outcome, side, price_le].

constants.name: PRICE_LEVEL_SEED
docs: Namespace for one active market-side-price queue.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_CONFIG_SEED
docs: Singleton protocol-governance configuration.

constants.name: SHARED_BOOK_SEED
docs: Independent execution root; legacy market queues remain recoverable.

constants.name: TEST_FAUCET_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Stateless PDA that owns the mint authority of faucet-enabled test mints.

constants.name: TEST_FAUCET_SEED
docs: Namespace for one market's explicitly configured test-token faucet.

constants.name: TRADER_BALANCE_SEED
docs: Seed for the canonical balance account belonging to one trader in one market.
PDA:
["trader_balance", market, trader]

constants.name: VAULT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Stateless PDA that owns both token vaults belonging to a market.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Token vault namespace; the remaining seeds are the market and asset mint.
